post.summary:
Starts connecting accounts of an OAuth platform. Send the user's browser to
`authorize_url`; the platform redirects it to the callback, which ends on `return_to` with
`result=ok&connect_id=…` (read the accounts with `GET /accounts/connect/{id}`, then confirm)
or `result=error&code=…`. Owner only.
post.description:
# Errors

422 `return_to_invalid` unless `return_to` is exactly an allowed return URL, 409
`capability_unsupported` for a credentials platform, 404 for an unknown platform, 503 when
the platform is not configured here.

403.description: `account_disabled`, `account_pending`, `delegation_invalid` (`X-Postit-Act-As` names no workspace the caller holds a live grant to) or `owner_only` (an owner-only action through `X-Postit-Act-As`)

post.summary:
Checks pasted credentials against the platform and lists the accounts they reach. The
body is a JSON object with the platform's credential fields. When the credential reaches
accounts, the response carries a one-time `connect_id` to confirm with.
post.description:
# Errors

422 `validation_failed` (every rule the values break, in `violations`) or
`credentials_invalid` (the field at fault, in `field`), 409 `capability_unsupported` for an
OAuth platform, 404 for an unknown platform, 429 when the credential-check limit is spent.

requestBody.description: The credential fields the platform asks for

403.description: `account_disabled`, `account_pending`, `delegation_invalid` (`X-Postit-Act-As` names no workspace the caller holds a live grant to), `owner_only` (an owner-only action through `X-Postit-Act-As`) or `capability_required` (the grant's level does not allow it)

post.summary:
Imports credential accounts from a CSV file (`Content-Type: text/csv`). The header row
lists the platform's credential fields and may add `display_name`. With `commit=false`
(the default) it only checks every row; with `commit=true` it connects the valid ones. The
report never contains a field value.
post.description:
# Errors

413 past the configured size, 422 for a bad header. A file over the row limit is read up to
the limit and the report says `truncated`.

parameters.name: commit
parameters.description: `true` connects the valid rows; `false` (the default) only checks the file.

post.summary:
Uploads a whole file in one request. The body is the raw file and `Content-Length` is
required. The stored type is what the bytes sniff as, never the request's `Content-Type`.
With an `Idempotency-Key`, a replay is recognized by the file name, `Content-Length`, and
`Content-Type` (the streamed body is not hashed).
post.description:
# Errors

413 `payload_too_large` (kind limit or single-request limit) or `storage_quota_exceeded`
before any byte is stored (with `max_bytes` either way), 415 `unsupported_media_type`, 422
`validation_failed` for a bad name, a missing `Content-Length`, or a body that does not
match it, and 408 `request_timeout` when the body sits idle too long.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description:
The file name, 1 to 255 characters. Its extension (`jpg`, `png`, `gif`, `webp`, `mp4`,
`m4v`, `mov`) picks the kind and so the size limit. Metadata only.

post.summary:
An event the platform sends, such as a deauthorization. Not called by clients. The agent
verifies it (a signature over the raw body, typically) and its reply is returned as is.
A verified deauthorization revokes every grant of that remote user on the platform.
post.description:
# Errors

401 with no detail when the agent cannot verify the event, 404 for an unknown or unavailable
platform or an event kind it does not handle, 413 past 64 KiB, 422 for a verified event the
agent cannot read.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: The agent's name for the event, such as `deauthorize`

requestBody.description: The platform's event, unmodified, at most 64 KiB

200.description: The agent's reply, in the status, `Content-Type`, and body the platform expects

403.description: `owner_only` (the request carried `X-Postit-Act-As`)

422.description: `validation_failed`: the event could not be read

get.summary:
The provider's redirect after the user signed in (or refused). Not called by clients: the
browser arrives here from the platform, without a bearer token, and `X-Postit-Act-As` is
ignored; the connection belongs to the user who started it.
get.description:
Always answers 303. The `Location` is the `return_to` the connection was started with,
carrying `result=ok&connect_id=…` on success (read the accounts with
`GET /accounts/connect/{id}`, then confirm) or `result=error&code=…`, where `code` is one of
`access_denied` (the user refused), `provider_error` (the provider reported another error or
sent no code), `exchange_failed` (the code could not be exchanged for tokens),
`scope_missing` (the user did not grant every permission the platform needs),
`discovery_failed` (the accounts could not be read), `no_accounts` (the sign-in reaches no
account), or `platform_unavailable` (the platform was switched off or is misconfigured). An
unknown, used, expired, or foreign `state` (`state_invalid`) goes to the web app's
`/oauth-done`, since no trustworthy `return_to` exists. Accounts another owner already
holds are skipped at confirm and counted in its `skipped_elsewhere`.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The `state` postit sent with the authorization request.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: The provider's OAuth error, such as `access_denied`.

parameters.name: error_description
parameters.description: The provider's description of the error. Ignored.

303.description: Back to `return_to` (or `/oauth-done`) with `result` and `connect_id` or `code`; see the operation description for the codes

AccountChangeDto.description: What confirming did to one account.

avatar_url.description: Profile picture, when the platform gives one.

oneOf.description: How it is connected; absent when this build has no agent for the platform.

last_checked_at.description: When the connection was last verified.

remote_account_id.description: The platform's ID for the account.

status.description: Whether the account can be used.

test_account.description: Whether publishing to it needs no live confirmation.

AccountStatusDto.description: Whether an account can be used.

AttemptDto.description: One execution attempt of a job.

error_code.description: Code of the error, if it failed.

error_kind.description: Kind of the error, if it failed.

error_message.description: Error message, if the job type shows it.

AuditEventDto.description: One entry of the audit log.

oneOf.description: Who performed the action; none for system actions.

details.description: Event details. Every `*_user_id` value is a `UserRef` object.

ip.description: Client IP, until it is cleared by retention.

oneOf.description: Owner of the workspace the action touched.

request_id.description: `X-Request-Id` of the request that caused the event.

AuditEventKindDto.description:
Every audit event kind (`AuditEventKind` in `postit-data`); the `OpenAPI` enum the web
client's kind filter is typed from. Clients must tolerate values added later.

AuthConfigDto.description: What a client needs to start the OIDC sign-in.

android_client_id.description: OAuth client ID of the Android app, or null when the deployment has none.

client_id.description: OAuth client ID of the web client.

ios_client_id.description: OAuth client ID of the iOS app, or null when the deployment has none.

issuer.description: Issuer URL of the identity provider.

ChangeDelegationRequest.description: Changes to a live delegation. Absent fields stay as they are.

account_ids.description: A new account limit, replacing the old one; an empty list means posts and media only.

all_accounts.description:
`true` lifts the account limit. `false` is refused: send `account_ids` instead.
Cannot be sent together with `account_ids`.

expires_at.description:
A new expiry in the future, or `null` to clear it. Absent leaves it unchanged, so a
client that always serializes nulls must send the current value to keep it.

account_ids.description: The `remote_id` of each account to connect; omit to connect every discovered account.

ConfirmResponse.description: The result of confirming a connection.

skipped_elsewhere.description: How many chosen accounts someone else already has connected.

unknown.description: Chosen IDs the credential did not reach.

ConnectedAccountDto.description: One connected account and what happened to it.

CredentialCheckResponse.description: The result of checking a pasted credential.

connect_id.description: Confirm with this ID. Shown once; absent when the credential reaches no account.

DelegationDto.description: A delegation: the owner lets the delegate act in the owner's workspace.

account_ids.description:
The accounts the delegate reaches when `all_accounts` is false (possibly none: posts
and media only). Empty when `all_accounts` is true.

all_accounts.description: Whether the delegate reaches every account; when false, only `account_ids`.

ended_at.description: When it ended; null while live.

oneOf.description: Why it ended; null while live.

expires_at.description: When it stops working; null for never.

owner.description: The user whose workspace it opens.

DelegationUserDto.description: One side of a delegation: a user by ID, current name, and status.

status.description: The user's account status. A grant only works while both users are `active`.

DeleteMeRequest.description: Confirmation for deleting one's own account.

display_name.description: Must equal the caller's current display name.

DisabledReasonDto.description: Why no action applies to a job: a stable code the clients translate.

cancelled_deliveries.description: Pending and parked deliveries that were cancelled.

native_scheduled_remaining.description: Deliveries still held for a later time on the platform's side.

DiscoveredAccountDto.description: An account a pasted credential or an OAuth sign-in reaches.

handle.description: The `@handle`, when the platform has one.

remote_id.description: The platform's ID for the account. Pass it to confirm to pick this account.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable problem code (the `code` member of every problem+json body).

GrantDelegationRequest.description: A new delegation in the caller's workspace.

account_ids.description:
Limit the grant to these of the caller's connected accounts; an empty list means posts
and media only. Absent means every account.

delegate_id.description: The user to let in: an `active` user other than the caller (see `/users/lookup`).

expires_at.description: When it stops working, in the future; absent or null for never.

ImportReportDto.description: The result of an import, in file order.

commit.description: Whether accounts were connected (`true`) or the file was only checked.

counts.description: How many rows ended each way, keyed by status.

truncated.description: The file has more rows than the server's row limit; the rest were not read.

ImportRowDto.description: The report line for one data row. Never carries a field value.

account_ids.description: The accounts created or matched; empty on a dry run.

display_name_ignored.description: A `display_name` was given but the row reaches more than one account.

field.description: The credential field at fault, when known.

JobActionResponse.description: The job a retry or trigger created.

JobActionsDto.description: The console actions the job currently offers.

cancel.description: Cancel the job before it runs.

delete.description: Delete the job and its history.

retry.description: Re-run the job as a new job.

JobCountDto.description: A count under a key (state, type or queue).

key.description: The state, type or queue name.

JobDetailDto.description: A job with its attempt history and retry links.

retried_by.description: The job created to retry this one.

retried_from.description: The job this one is a manual retry of.

oneOf.description: Why no action applies, when none does.

finished_at.description: When the job reached a final state.

recurring_name.description: Name of the recurring schedule that enqueued it.

run_at.description: When the job is (or was) due.

started_at.description: When the current or last attempt started.

JobStateDto.description: Where a job is in its life. Clients must tolerate values added later.

window_hours.description: Length of the throughput window in hours.

LevelDto.description: What a delegate may do in the owner's workspace.

LocaleDto.description: A language the interface and emails can be shown in.

LookupResponse.description: The result of a user lookup.

oneOf.description: The one matching user, or null.

account_url.description: The identity provider's account page (`auth.oidc.account_url`), when configured.

derived_from.description: The asset this one was fitted from.

mime.description: The MIME type the bytes sniffed as; unset until the upload completes.

original_filename.description: The name the uploaded file had. Metadata only; it never reaches a path.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the stored bytes, once known.

status.description: Where it is in its life.

MediaStatusDto.description: Where a media asset is in its upload and processing life.

quota_bytes.description: The quota in bytes; 0 means unlimited.

used_bytes.description: Bytes stored or reserved by open uploads.

authorize_url.description: Send the user's browser here to sign in to the platform. It carries a one-time `state`.

expires_at.description: When the sign-in must be finished by.

mime.description: The MIME type the bytes sniffed as; unset until the upload completes.

items.description: A postit user as admins and the user themselves see it. Profile fields come from the identity provider.

approved_at.description: When an admin approved the user.

approved_by.description: The admin who approved the user.

email.description: Email address from the identity provider, when it supplied one.

email_verified.description: Whether the provider verified the email address.

PendingConnectionDto.description:
A connection waiting for the user to pick accounts, from pasted credentials or an OAuth
sign-in.

connect.description: How the accounts would be connected.

discovered.description: The accounts it reaches; confirm with the `remote_id`s to connect.

expires_at.description: When the connection can no longer be confirmed.

locale.description: The language of the interface and of emails sent to the caller.

ProblemDetails.description: The RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` body every error response carries.

field.description: `credentials_invalid`: the credential field at fault, when known.

missing_scopes.description: `credentials_invalid`: scopes the credentials lack, when the platform says.

request_id.description: The `X-Request-Id` of the failed request, for support.

title.description: Short summary of the problem type.

violations.description: `validation_failed` on account routes: every rule the input broke, by field.

RecurringJobDto.description: A recurring job and its schedule.

last_run_at.description: When the newest run was scheduled.

next_run_at.description: When the next run is due.

StartOAuthRequest.description: Where the browser goes back to once the platform's sign-in is over.

return_to.description:
Exactly one of the deployment's allowed return URLs: the web app's `/oauth-done`, the
mobile app's `<scheme>://oauth-done`, or a configured entry. No prefix match, query, or
fragment.

ThroughputBucketDto.description: Attempt outcomes within one time bucket.

UpdateAccountRequest.description: Settings the owner may change on an account.

test_account.description: Mark or unmark the account as a test account.

locale.description: `en-US` or `ar`; anything else is rejected with `validation_failed`.

UploadOffsetDto.description: Where an upload stands after a chunk.

offset.description: Bytes stored so far; the next chunk starts here.

expires_at.description: When the session expires if left open.

id.description: The asset ID the upload becomes.

filename.description:
The file name, 1 to 255 characters. Its extension (`jpg`, `png`, `gif`, `webp`, `mp4`,
`m4v`, `mov`) picks the kind and so the size limit.

size.description: The whole file's size in bytes.

UserDto.description: A postit user as admins and the user themselves see it. Profile fields come from the identity provider.

approved_at.description: When an admin approved the user.

approved_by.description: The admin who approved the user.

email.description: Email address from the identity provider, when it supplied one.

email_verified.description: Whether the provider verified the email address.

last_seen_at.description: When the user last made an authenticated request.

updated_at.description: When the user was last changed.

UserRef.description:
A user reference in the audit log. `deleted` is true for a pseudonym left by user
deletion (a UUID v8, which postit never generates otherwise). `display_name` is the
user's current name, or null for a pseudonym or a user no longer present.

deleted.description: Whether the user has been deleted.

display_name.description: The user's current name, when known.

id.description: User ID, or the pseudonym that replaced it.

ViewUrlsDto.description: Short-lived signed URLs for showing an asset.

thumbnail_url.description: Its thumbnail, when it has one.

WorkspaceDto.description: A workspace the caller can act in: their own, or one a live grant opens.

account_ids.description:
The accounts the caller reaches when `all_accounts` is false; null for the caller's
own.

all_accounts.description: Whether the caller reaches every account here; null for the caller's own.

delegation_id.description: The grant that opens it; null for the caller's own.

oneOf.description: What the caller may do here; null for the caller's own (everything).

own.description: Whether this is the caller's own workspace.

owner.description:
The workspace's owner. Send their ID in `X-Postit-Act-As` to act here (not for the
caller's own workspace).
